title: Creation
study_note: Created being depends on God; creation is received as gift, not identified with God.

title: Covenant
study_note: God binds people to himself in faithful promise, fulfilled in the new covenant in Christ.

title: Image of God
study_note: Human dignity and renewal are understood in relation to God and Christ, the image of the invisible God.

title: Light and Darkness
study_note: The biblical image of light connects creation with revelation, holiness and life in Christ.

title: New Creation
study_note: God renews persons and creation; spiritual transformation is directed toward communion with God.

title: Kingdom of God
study_note: God’s reign concerns righteousness, peace and the fulfillment of his purposes.

title: Baptism
study_note: Water, deliverance and new life connect baptism with Christ’s death and resurrection; traditions explain its operation differently.

title: Eucharist and Communion
study_note: Passover, bread and covenant inform Christian communion; sacramental interpretations differ across traditions.

title: Church and Fellowship
study_note: God gathers a people whose shared life expresses unity, mutual care and worship.

title: Discipleship
study_note: Following Christ means learning his teaching and embodying it in daily life.

title: Self-Denial
study_note: Self-denial redirects desire toward God and loving service rather than contempt for embodied life.

title: Discernment
study_note: Spiritual discernment tests teaching and conduct in the light of truth and the fruit of love.

title: Spiritual Warfare
study_note: Spiritual struggle calls for prayer, fidelity and resistance to evil, not violence against other people.

title: Angels
study_note: Angels serve God’s purposes; biblical worship is directed to God rather than to his messengers.

title: Stewardship of Creation
study_note: Human responsibility for creation follows from belonging to God and caring for what he has made.

title: Fasting
study_note: Fasting is joined to repentance, justice and prayer, not merely outward deprivation.

title: Rest and Sabbath
study_note: Created rest and Sabbath point toward trust in God and the rest described in Hebrews.

title: Thanksgiving
study_note: Gratitude receives life as gift and turns remembrance into praise and faithful action.

title: Perseverance
study_note: Steadfast hope endures trial through trust in God and sustained faithful action.

title: Reconciliation
study_note: Reconciliation joins restored relationship with God to truth, forgiveness and peace with others.

title: Second Coming
study_note: Christian hope awaits Christ without supplying dates that Scripture does not give.

title: God’s Presence
study_note: God transcends creation yet makes himself present in covenant, Christ and the Spirit.
